searchText: Could we also have someone (<@727296082484265073>?) champion the alternative EIP-3074? https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/a-case-for-a-simpler-alternative-to-eip-3074 imo 5806 is a much more coherent version of this, i don't think it makes sense to make commits this structured within the evm Will the link for the call just be shared here or do we need to opt in to get a link? A few people from our team would like to listen in depending on the time selected. I'll share it here! Seems like the 28th is the most popular option. Unless there are objections in the next couple hours, I'll update the Github issue with that time 🔜 ! Same day as Pragma Denver - I'll find a quiet spot to listen in though. Thanks! For EthDenver that equates to 7am local time, still on standard time. Finalized the date here, and added the call to the Protocols calendar: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/962
